AI for Mathematics Workshop on Lean, Automated Reasoning and Beyond

Dear Lean community,

I'm excited to share that Peking University is organizing a conference titled "AI for Mathematics Workshop on Lean, Automated Reasoning and Beyond" from September 2nd to 6th. The first part of the conference will feature talks, while the latter part will be a hands-on Lean workshop. The featured talks will be approximately 1/3 focused on AI and 2/3 focused on Lean, reflecting the workshop's emphasis on Lean while also exploring AI applications in mathematics.

The university recently concluded a five-week summer school on Lean, where 20-30 talented undergraduate students demonstrated remarkable enthusiasm for formalization and acquired fundamental skills in Lean. Each student successfully formalized approximately 20 abstract algebra exercises. The goal of this workshop is to further promote Lean in China, foster collaboration with the AI community, and provide students with opportunities to enhance their Lean skills and initiate new projects under the guidance of experts.

The organizers would be honoured if members of the Lean community would be interested in attending the conference and sharing valuable insights on Lean formalization. It would be immensely beneficial for the students if you could also participate in the workshop and lead a Lean project. For invited speakers and project leaders, the university will cover the cost of airfare and hotel accommodations.

Regarding visas, China offers a visa-free program for passport holders from many European countries for stays up to 15 days. You can find more information here: https://www.china-briefing.com/news/china-visa-free-travel-policies-complete-guide/. It is likely many attendees will not need a visa for this trip.

If you are interested in attending the conference and/or giving a talk, please contact me directly on Zulip. I will be happy to provide you with additional information or connect you with the organizers.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
